title: City Council District 2
statement: I’m holding further work on Baylight this week. The board marks it complete, but the brief does not provide a current milestone finding that would justify another step. In D2, Jack London’s sentiment remains positive and its crime index is below the city figure; those conditions are worth recognizing, not a reason to claim an unverified project result.

payload.text: My stated support for Downtown Economic Revitalization was my public position, not proof that I cast a YES vote. The current initiative record says INIT-008 is failed and vote-scheduled for C114, but this brief does not provide a roll call or identify my vote. The legislative outcome recorded here is that the initiative failed; I cannot claim a specific individual vote or a more detailed decision without that record.
